_meta.note: Guideline source registry for care-plan citations. Medical-lens drafted; SME sign-off pending (GB-3). These are reference-level pointers to published guideline families, NOT extracted clinical criteria. Every consumer must surface the not-SME-reviewed state (coalition design g5-careplan.md section 3.4).

ada-soc-glycemic.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes — Glycemic Assessment (A1C testing cadence and goals)

ncqa-hedis.title: NCQA HEDIS Measure Specifications (quality-gap closure requirements)

uspstf-depression.title: USPSTF Recommendation — Screening for Depression and Suicide Risk (Grade B); includes perinatal screening

aap-bright-futures.title: AAP Bright Futures — Periodicity Schedule for Well-Child Preventive Care

gravity-sdohcc.title: Gravity Project SDOH Clinical Care — social-risk screening and referral coding guidance

ahrq-care-coordination.title: AHRQ Care Coordination Measures Atlas — coordination, education, and follow-up practice base

ags-beers.title: AGS Beers Criteria — medication review and deprescribing in older adults (polypharmacy)

cms-hcc-guidance.title: CMS-HCC Risk Adjustment — documentation and coding guidance (support the diagnosis in the encounter record)

cms-ccm.title: CMS Chronic Care Management guidance — structured follow-up, remote monitoring, and care-plan review
